{{Quote|Mostly sunny; glare goggles recommended; winds up to 85 kph; seismic shifting should subside by week's end; exposed skin will freeze in less than four minutes.|HoloNet News Weather Report|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|weather.html|Weather Report}}</ref>}}
'''Sun-goggles''', or '''glare goggles''', were a specialized type of [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] that featured polarized lenses to protect from glaring [[Star/Legends|suns]] common on sunny [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Members of the [[Enso/Legends|Enso]] [[Species/Legends|species]] often wore such goggles to supplement the cooling properties of their [[coolth suit]]s on hot worlds.<ref name="DB CTR">{{DB|character|teyorarekab|Rekab, Captain Teyora}}</ref>
